Solve the supplied rule-constrained task. Return short JSON matching the response schema. Jointly propose an executable rule sketch and any entity/group/usage interface. Do not omit exceptions. A compiled unit needs a source link to a binding or query; unlisted units remain residual. Do not claim unsupported text is compiled. program.kind is expression, connector, unsupported, or public_horn. For public_horn use empty body {} and compiled_units listing only the public sentences already read/compiled. The trusted bounded Horn backend handles query and rules. Unread ground facts remain complete Boolean observations, never assumed absent. For expression body use bindings [{name,value,type,source}], query {op,args}, source_links {unit:[node]}. Types: integer, rational (decimal string), scalar. Connectors also accept relation A string input uses type scalar, not string. Expression names start with n_ for numbers, s_ for strings, b_ for booleans; source IDs such as s0 are provenance only. An expression body requires bindings, query and source_links. Do not copy every source sentence into bindings; bind only public literals needed by an executable query. If no faithful query is available, use unsupported with body {} and keep the native answer separate. {columns,rows,closed}, amount (one value,unit,owner,period,lineage,stage object), amounts (a list of these objects), allowance_bank (entries key,balance,policy,order_observable), resource_key, slot_list. Do not invent entity witnesses or guess allocation policies. A variable is {var:name}. Operators: if,and,or,not,eq,ne,lt,le,add,sub,min,max,scale (literal constant first), divide_constant (literal denominator), array,pair,object,concat. No arbitrary code. Bind observed values and rule constants from public source units. Node names are query and binding:NAME. Use unsupported with empty body when faithful executable translation is unavailable. Always give your task answer in answer; this fixed fallback has no stability certificate. Interface proposals may describe a source-linked join/group/map/reduce graph, but never use source IDs or answers as routing features. Each interfaces entry has exactly fields (allowed semantic field names), graph (connector DSL), and bindings (same source-linked binding format); use [] when unavailable. A connector body has bindings,candidates,source_links,project; optional query wraps its result. Projection modes: identity, amount_value (one Amount), amount_values (list of Amount), entailment_label (Boolean claim to binary Entailment/Contradiction). A wrapper query reads n_result/b_result/s_result, or n_result_0,n_result_1,... for numeric list results. Never bind these output names as public inputs. An expression variable may remain unbound only if public text itself declares its full finite domain: Boolean b_NAME = true/false.; Integer n_NAME in [integers] = integer.; or Enum s_NAME in [strings] = string. Keep its untranslated source unit residual. Other unread text has unknown scope; do not invent domains or missing rules. Do not store case amounts or names as reusable skill constants. Answer contract: "True", "False", or "Unknown"
